articles.title: Two Decades Later, 'Superman Returns' Still Defies Easy Labels
articles.summary: Bryan Singer's 'Superman Returns' turns 20 this weekend, and it remains a fascinating contradiction: a sequel that ignores two prior films while rebooting the franchise with a new cast. Its devotion to the 1978 classic extended to using John Williams' iconic score note-for-note.

articles.title: NASA Awards $18,000 to Student Teams for Next-Gen Lunar Life Support Designs
articles.summary: Cal Poly won the 2026 Human Lander Challenge and a $10,000 prize for a Peltier-based water system. The competition tasked university teams with improving environmental control and life support for future crewed lunar landers under NASA's Artemis program.

articles.title: Stunning Footage Captures China's Tiangong Space Station Transiting the Moon
articles.summary: Astrophotographer Efrain Morales recorded China's Tiangong space station passing in front of the Moon in less than a second on May 29. The silhouette of its solar panels and modules is clearly visible against the lunar surface near Tycho Crater.
